dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave curvature on the trailing edge, exhibiting a steep spline transition from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a very small pixel radius, creating a sharp morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep angular inclination of approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High verticality with an approximate height-to-base ratio of 1.6:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convex curvature along the anterior-dorsal boundary, forming a rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust pixel length extending from the melon, showing significant thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, light-colored punctate markings or circular lesions visible on the dorsal surface of the caudal flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: Wide, symmetrical caudal flukes with a distinct median notch and a single visible pectoral fin extending ventrolaterally.
